packageRules.description: global.json's SDK version, the Dockerfiles' dotnet/sdk and dotnet/aspnet image tags, and the annotated dotnet-version CI inputs have to move together - a mismatch between global.json/CI and the Dockerfile's SDK image breaks 'dotnet restore --locked-mode' on src/Vfps/Vfps.csproj, whose packages.lock.json pins Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets to whatever ASP.NET Core runtime the build-stage SDK bundles.
